title: Salesforce reports 84% resolution and 4% human handoff for Agentforce on its help site
summary: Six months after going live on help.salesforce.com on 11 October 2024, Salesforce said Agentforce had handled more than 500,000 conversations, resolved more than 84% of customer questions, and handed 4% of conversations to a human support engineer, a rate the company says it keeps on purpose. The agent is grounded on nearly 740,000 pieces of help-portal content, routes renewal questions to a live engineer, and the team reviews conversations that moved to a human to find knowledge gaps and refine its skills; an editor's note adds that conversations passed 1 million by July 2025.
verification_note: URL fetched 2026-10-17; publication date 2025-04-22 and all figures (500,000+ conversations, 84%+ resolution, 4% handoff, nearly 740,000 content items, 11 October 2024 go-live, 1 million by July 2025 in an editor's note) confirmed from the article body, a Q&A with Bernard Slowey, SVP Digital Customer Success. The page does not describe tool calls or transactions beyond answering and handing off, so the item sits at the support-assistant end of 'agent'; kept for its deliberate deferral budget, routing rules and handoff-review loop.
